title: Kicked Up Spicy Peruvian Chicken Skewers
description: Spicy and crispy Peruvian chicken skewers made with shoyu-koji and ferment-jang, perfect for a hangover cure, featuring ayurvedic-tamasic-friendly ingredients. This dish combines the flavors of Peru with a kick of spice.
instructions: Preheat the grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together shoyu-koji, ferment-jang, ayurvedic tamasic spice blend, lime juice, and olive oil.
Add the chicken to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the chicken onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the chicken is cooked through.
Brush the skewers with additional olive oil and sprinkle with minced garlic and grated ginger.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with fresh cilantro and lime wedges.
Let the skewers rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve with your favorite sides, such as grilled vegetables or quinoa.
